meta.description: Starter test set for the GoEmotions classifier used by MoodBite, labelled at the Ekman level (6 basic emotions + neutral).
meta.annotation: Written and labelled by the project author (single annotator). Before citing results in the report, have at least one more person label the same sentences independently and report agreement (for example Cohen's kappa); drop or relabel sentences where annotators disagree.
